mapper.select:
SELECT fa.id, fa.post_id AS discussionId, p.title, p.course_id AS courseId, p.course_name AS courseName, fa.excerpt, fa.teacher_name AS teacherName, fa.is_recommended AS isRecommended, fa.update_time AS updatedAt FROM community_featured_answer fa INNER JOIN community_post p ON fa.post_id = p.id AND p.is_delete = 0 WHERE fa.is_delete = 0
AND p.course_id = #{courseId}
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR fa.excerpt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY fa.is_recommended DESC, fa.sort_order DESC, fa.create_time DESC
ORDER BY fa.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_featured_answer ( post_id, reply_id, teacher_id, teacher_name, excerpt, is_recommended, sort_order, is_delete, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{replyId}, #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{excerpt}, #{isRecommended}, #{sortOrder}, #{isDelete}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
